spans.s: शुतुद्रि f. The river Sutlej. Cf. शतद्रु.
शुतुद्रि f. The river Sutlej. Cf. शतद्रु.
सुत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Poured out; 2. extracted; 3. begotten, brought forth.
सुत (II) m. 1. A son, दिगंतविश्रांतरथो हि तत्सुतः R.iii.4; 2. a king.
सुत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Poured out; 2. extracted; 3. begotten, brought forth.
सुता f. A daughter, सुतां तदीयां सुरभेः कृत्वा प्रतिनिधिं शुचिः R.i.81.
सूत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Born, engendered, produced; 2. impelled.

सूत (II) m. 1. A charioteer, सूत ऐशानीं दिशं प्रति चोदयाश्वान् आशुगमनाय Vikr.i.; 2. the son of a Kṣatriya by a woman of the Brāhmaṇa caste, क्षत्रियाद्विप्रकन्यायां सूतो भवति जातितः M.x.11; 3. a bard; 4. a carpenter; 5. the sun; 6. name of a pupil of Vyāsa.
सूत (III) m.n. quick-silver.
सूत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Born, engendered, produced; 2. impelled.
सूता f. A woman recently delivered.
सुत-आत्मज m. a grand-son.
सुत-आत्मजा f. a grand-daughter.
सुत-उत्पत्ति f. birth of a son.
सुतंगम m. the father of a son.
सुत-निर्विशेषम् ind. just like a son.
सुत-वत् (I) a. having sons.
सुत-वत् (II) m. the father of a son.
सुत-वस्करा f. the mother of seven children.
सुत-स्नेह m. paternal affection.
सुतनु (I) a. 1. Having a beautiful body; 2. extremely fine, slender, thin.
सुतनु (II) f. A beautiful lady, सुतनु हृदयात्प्रत्यादेशव्यलीकमपैतु ते Sak.vii.
सुतपस् (I) a. 1. One who practises severe penance; 2. having great heat.
सुतपस् (II) m. 1. An ascetic, a devotee, an anchorite; 2. the sun.
सुतपस् (III) n. Severe penance.

सुतराम् ind. 1. Better, more excellently; 2. exceedingly, much, excessively, धेन्वा तदध्यासितकातराक्ष्या निरीक्ष्यमाणः सुतरां दयालुः R.ii.52; 3. more positively, मय्यप्यास्था न ते चेत् त्वयि मम सुतरामेष राजन् गतोऽस्मि Bhartr.iii.30.
सुतर्दन m. The Indian cuckoo.
सुतल n. 1. Immense depth; 2. one of the seven worlds below the earth; 3. the base of a large building.
सुति f. Extraction of the Soma juice.
सूति f. 1. Birth, production, delivery, child-bearing; 2. offspring, progeny; 3. source, तपसां सूतिरसूतिरापदाम् Kir.ii.56; 4. a place where Soma juice is extracted.
सुतिक्तक m. The coral tree.
सुतिन् (I) a. (f. नी) Having children.
सुतिन् (II) m. A father.
सुतिन् (I) a. (f. नी) Having children.
सुतिनी f. A mother, तेनांबा यदि सुतिनी Hit.i.
सुतीक्ष्ण (I) a. (f. क्ष्णा) 1. Very sharp; 2. very pungent; 3. acutely painful.
सुतीक्ष्ण (II) m. 1. The Śigru tree; 2. name of a sage, नाम्ना सुतीक्ष्णश्चरितेन दांतः R.xiii.41.
सुतीक्ष्ण (I) a. (f. क्ष्णा) 1. Very sharp; 2. very pungent; 3. acutely painful.
सुतीक्ष्ण-दशन m. an epithet of Śiva.
सुतीर्थ n. A good preceptor.
सुतुंग (I) a. (f. गा) Very lofty.
सुतुंग (II) m. The cocoanut tree.
सुतुंग (I) a. (f. गा) Very lofty.
सुतुस् a. Well-sounding.
सुत्या f. 1. Extraction of the Soma juice; 2. a sacrificial ablution; 3. parturition.
सूत्या f. The same as सुत्या q.v.
सुत्वन् m. 1. An offerer of Soma juice; 2. a student who has performed his ablutions (subsequent or preparatory to a sacrifice).
सूत् ind. An imitative sound.
सूत-तनय m. an epithet of Karṇa.
सूत-राज् m. quick-silver.
सूतक (I) n. 1. Birth, production, M.iv.112; 2. impurity from child-birth or miscarriage.
सूतक (II) m. quick-silver.
सूतका f. A woman recently delivered, M.iv.212.
सूतका f. A woman recently delivered, M.iv.212.
सूतिका f. A woman recently delivered.
सूति-अशौच n. impurity caused by child-birth (continuing for ten days).
सूति-गृह n. the lying-in chamber.
सूतिमास m. the month of delivery, the last month of pregnancy.
सूतिमास m. the month of delivery, the last month of pregnancy.
सूतिका-अगार, -गृह, -भवन n. a room appropriated to a woman at child-birth.
सूतिका-अगार, -गृह, -भवन n. a room appropriated to a woman at child-birth.
सूतिका-अगार, -गृह, -भवन n. a room appropriated to a woman at child-birth.
सूतिका-रोग m. puerperal sickness.
सूतिका-षष्ठी f. a particular goddess worshipped on the sixth day after child-birth.
सूत्तर a. (f. रा) 1. Very superior; 2. well towards the north.
सूत्तर a. (f. रा) 1. Very superior; 2. well towards the north.
सूत्थान (I) a. (f. ना) Making good effort, clever.
सूत्थान (II) n. Good effort or exertion.
सूत्थान (I) a. (f. ना) Making good effort, clever.
सूत्पर n. The distilling of spirituous liquor.

सूत्र् vt. 10U (pres. सूत्रयति-ते) 1. To tie, to bind, to string, to write in the form of a concise rule, e.g. जैमिनिरपीदमपि धर्मलक्षणमसूत्रयत्; 2. to plan, to systematize, निसृष्टार्थदूतीकल्पः सूत्रयितव्यः M.M.i.; 3. to unbind, to loosen.

सूत्र n. 1. A thread, string, line, cord, मणौ वज्रसमुत्कीर्णे सूत्रस्येवास्ति मे गतिः R.i.4, Bg.vii.7; 2. a fibre, कर्षति खण्डिताग्रात् सूत्रं मृणालादिव राजहंसी Vikr.i., K.S.i.40; 3. a collection of threads; 4. the sacred thread or cord worn by the first three classes, पाणौ कार्मुकमक्षसूत्रवलयं दंडोऽपरः पैप्पलः Mv.i., K.S.iii.46; 5. the string or wire of a puppet; 6. a short rule or precept; 7. any work or manual containing such aphoristic rules, (e.g. आपस्तंबसूत्र, बौधायनसूत्र); 8. a short concise sentence used as a memorial rule; (it is thus defined- स्वल्पाक्षरमसंदिग्धं सारवद्विश्वतोमुखम् । अस्तोभमनवद्यं च सूत्रं सूत्रविदो विदुः); 9. any rule, canon or decree (in law).
सूत्र-आत्मन् (I) a. having the nature of a string or thread.
सूत्र-आत्मन् (II) m. the soul.
सूत्र-आली f. a string of beads worn round the neck, a necklace.
सूत्र-कंठ m. 1. a Brāhmaṇa; 2. a pigeon, a dove; 3. a wagtail.
सूत्र-कर्मन् n. carpentry.
सूत्र-कार, -कृत् m. an author or composer of sūtras.
सूत्र-कार, -कृत् m. an author or composer of sūtras.
सूत्र-कोण, -कोणक m. a small drum, a ḍamaru.
सूत्र-कोण, -कोणक m. a small drum, a ḍamaru.
सूत्र-गंडिका f. a kind of stick used by weavers in spinning threads.
सूत्र-चरण n. name of a class of charaṇas or Vedic schools that introduced various sūtra works.
सूत्र-दरिद्रता f. paucity of fibres or threads, अयं पटः सूत्रदरिद्रतां गतः Mrich.ii.

सूत्र-धर, -धार m. 1. a stage-manager, a principal actor who arranges the plot of a drama and takes the leading part in the prelude, अपि कुसुमपृषत्कैर्देवदेवस्य जेता जयति सुरतलीलानाटिकासूत्रधारः Vid.Bh.i.; 2. a carpenter; 3. the author of a set of aphorisms; 4. an epithet of Indra.

सूत्र-धर, -धार m. 1. a stage-manager, a principal actor who arranges the plot of a drama and takes the leading part in the prelude, अपि कुसुमपृषत्कैर्देवदेवस्य जेता जयति सुरतलीलानाटिकासूत्रधारः Vid.Bh.i.; 2. a carpenter; 3. the author of a set of aphorisms; 4. an epithet of Indra.
सूत्र-पिटक m. name of one of the three collections of Buddhistic writings.
सूत्र-पुष्प m. the cotton plant.
सूत्र-भिद् m. a tailor.
सूत्र-भृत् m. the same as सूत्रधार q.v.
सूत्र-यंत्र n. 1. a thread-machine, a shuttle; 2. a weaver’s loom.
सूत्र-ला f. a spindle or distaff.
सूत्र-वीणा f. a kind of lute.
सूत्र-वेष्टन n. a weaver’s shuttle.
सूत्रण n. 1. The act of stringing together or putting in order; 2. arranging in aphorisms.
सू(सु)त्रामन् m. An epithet of Indra.
सू(सु)त्रामन् m. An epithet of Indra.
सूत्रिका f. A kind of dish.
सूत्रिन् (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Having threads; 2. having rules.
सूत्रिन् (II) m. A crow.
सूत्रिन् (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Having threads; 2. having rules.
सूत्रित a. (f. ता) 1. Strung, arranged, methodized; 2. prescribed or enjoined in aphorisms.
सूत्रित a. (f. ता) 1. Strung, arranged, methodized; 2. prescribed or enjoined in aphorisms.
